allowed_public_statement: a public/archive alert-context record was found and mapped to evidence demands
blocked_statement: alerting readiness is closed or proven
reason: archive lacks local originator, ack/error, EAS/WEA delivery, evaluator, and CAP/retest evidence

allowed_public_statement: archive acquisition is pending, unavailable, or did not find a public archive record under stated filters
blocked_statement: no alert was issued or alerting failed
reason: archive lag, geocode, proprietary channels, pagination, and filtering can create false negatives

allowed_public_statement: message lineage requires adjudication and non-regression review
blocked_statement: initial message remains current or corrected message closed the issue
reason: superseded/cancelled records must be resolved against local packets

allowed_public_statement: exercise/test message context captured for evaluation
blocked_statement: actual public emergency alert was sent to the public

claim_path: source aliases point to same URL
allowed_public_statement: multiple source IDs share a canonical URL cluster
reason: source-ID duplication is not independent evidence
public oversight feeds cap/contradict/reconcile but do not replace local packets
